chunk.description: Volume chunk: data/volumes/books-cNNNNN.json.gz — gzip JSON array of 100 full book records (last chunk may be partial only mid-drip; sealed chunks are exactly 100).

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical chunk bytes.

creation_mode.description: Derived from origin. ORIGINAL = origin 'original' (standalone Signature work). DERIVED = any other origin (seeded by a network record; lineage in sources[]).

index_entry.description: Compact per-book row in data/index/books.idx.json.gz (gzip JSON array). Field map kept short for wire size; full records live in the volume chunks.

record_status.description: Internal publication state. The public catalog only ever lists PUBLISHED books.

description: Permanent record standard for The Signature Book Depository. Every book carries one immutable JAH-BOOK-###### ID (never reused, never changed by a title change). Records are immutable: books are only written once finished (record status PUBLISHED by construction; the drip's state.json next_index never revisits an ID), so BOOK ID and BOOK VERSION stay 1:1 — a corrected book would be issued a new version, never a silent overwrite. No real-world authors, no borrowed text, no trademarked characters, no fake ISBNs or publishers. No license field is invented: reuse rights are stated per record as read/copy/download permitted.

author.description: Signature-system author name (generated persona). Never a real-world author.

chapters.description: Full book content, chapter by chapter. A finished book always ships complete chapters — 'Every book finished' means every displayed book passed this bar.

b.description: Chapter body text. Poetry preserves line breaks; prose uses blank-line paragraph breaks.

genre.description: Display genre. Mutually exclusive: exactly one per book; genre counts sum to total_books.

gkey.description: Machine genre key (e.g. scifi, poetry, techmanual).

id.description: Permanent immutable book ID. Canonical URL: https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/signature-books/?book=<ID>

note.description: Honesty note carried on every book: an original generated work by the Signature system; all names/places/events invented.

origin.description: Creation slot. Mutually exclusive: exactly one per book. 'original' = standalone Signature-original (CREATION-MODE ORIGINAL). The other six = DERIVED: the book was seeded by that network record type and carries a source-lineage link in sources[].

sources.description: Source-lineage records. Empty for standalone originals. Each entry links the exact network record that seeded the book.

url.description: Deep link to the exact source record.

title.description: Book title. Unique across the catalog (the drip appends ' (Vol. N)' on collision).

words.description: Total word count (title + description + all chapters).

title: JAH-BOOK-RECORD/1.0
